<tool_use query_database {"sql": "SELECT * FROM reviews LIMIT 100;"}>
---
Based on the customer feedback in the reviews table, thermal bottles receive mixed ratings with customers praising their insulation capabilities but reporting durability and functionality issues like lid difficulty, leaking, and paint chipping. Tumblers have generally positive feedback focused on practical features like cup holder fit, though some customers note minor issues such as squeaky straws.
